capabilities.text: Plot up to three bonds on the same axes
Give each bond a name of your own
Type each bond's length and bond energy
Measure the lengths in pm, Å or nm
Write the energies as kJ/mol or as kJ mol⁻¹
Draw dashed guides from each minimum across to both axes
Label the guides with their values, with the words Bond length and Bond energy, with blank lines, or not at all
capabilities.note: Values is the default label. Each token passes on guides alone; checked by hand that each label choice renders differently from guides=true with values.

capabilities.text: Put a dot on the minimum of each curve
Write Repulsion and Attraction on either side of one curve's minimum, as words or as blank lines
Name the bonds in a key, or hide the names as Bond A, B and C
capabilities.note: The opening shows the names in a key.

capabilities.text: Number the axes and fit them to the curves in one step
capabilities.note: Fit is on at the opening; the token moves the minimum and the axes refit (checked by hand that the same change with fit=false keeps the old axes).

capabilities.text: Draw shape-only axes, with only the zero marked on the energy axis
Draw the curves in color or in black and white
Give the chart a title as your own text, a blank line, or none
capabilities.note: The opening has no title (Text with an empty title), so None is the opening; checked by hand that Blank line renders differently from the typed title.

capabilities.text: Give each axis title as your own text, a blank line, or none
capabilities.evidence: changes:xtitle=Distance between nuclei (pm) + changes:xtitle_mode=Blank line + changes:ytitle_mode=None

capabilities.text: Type each axis's range and count-by
Number every line, every 2nd, 5th or 10th line, or no lines on each axis
Draw the gridlines light, standard or bold, or leave them off
capabilities.note: ours turns gridlines on or off only (grid); no weights

capabilities.text: Add minor gridlines, 2, 4 or 5 per block
Choose the label size
Write a label at the far end of each axis, as your own text or none
capabilities.note: no axis end labels (the axis titles are cap-07c)

capabilities.text: Finish each end of each axis plainly or with an arrowhead
capabilities.note: no end-cap control: shape-only axes always get arrowheads, numbered axes always plain ends
